question: Should OpenClaw standardize the narrow `openclaw commands` inventory, and exactly which JSON and plugin metadata fields should be supported compatibility contracts in its first version?
rationale: The proposal intentionally leaves the permanent namespace, stable schema, plugin-facing `CommandExposure` status, and relationship to Gateway `commands.list` unresolved; implementation proof cannot choose those contracts.

options.title: Adopt the narrow commands catalog
options.body: Approve list and exact inspection after the discussion defines the initial stable fields, plugin metadata status, and distinction from Gateway `commands.list`.

options.title: Adopt the broader catalog surface
options.body: Choose the distinct `catalog` namespace and broader operational lenses, accepting a larger initial public contract.

options.title: Defer a unified inventory
options.body: Keep existing registries separate until a stronger canonical consumer or convergence plan establishes the required contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow commands catalog
recommendation.body: Approve list and exact inspection after the discussion defines the initial stable fields, plugin metadata status, and distinction from Gateway `commands.list`.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the repository's RFC lifecycle and template contract, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the acceptance-process and product-boundary decision.
